significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish that a fact’s training reliability is encoded as a signal "distinct from both the fact content and the model's output logit confidence" and that this signal causally controls hedging, deferral, and acceptance of corrections; this establishes both an internal mechanism and its behavioral phenomenon. It is chiefly form (ii)—the separable-direction, causal-role, and steering-repair template—rather than a law predicting behavior across unseen configurations, so despite covering several closely related uncertainty behaviors it remains bounded near the topic median; Kadavath et al. (2022) and Kuhn et al. (2023) show why distinguishing internal reliability from behavioral or output-level uncertainty would constrain explanations of calibration, but the claim does not specify a quantitative dependence among them. Verified-false would informatively disfavor a distinct linearly readable and causally used provenance variable in favor of confidence/content-based accounts, although it would not rule out nonlinear or distributed provenance representations; the two branches are therefore distinguishable but asymmetric. Topic-substitution check: the general knowledge-retrieval topic would not earn this score by itself—the specific content-independent provenance variable and its causal control of three doubt responses supply the incremental value.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "provenance probe" and the "steerable internal quantity," including an "AUROC for predicting incorrect answers" on natural facts; the predictor is potentially ex ante because retrieval-time activations could flag an unreliable answer before it is trusted, while steering supplies a decode-time control over hedging or deferral. Unlike a purely post-hoc confidence analysis, that predictor could be used by model auditors or deployment systems, a practical need reflected in work on semantic-entropy hallucination detection such as Farquhar et al. (2024), although the claim does not state a concrete shipping or gating rule. After re-extraction, the conclusion predicts that a reliability-class signal distinct from logits should recur, but it does not provide a quantitative invariant, threshold, or scaling law for a new model, and the allowance for "a small recalibration" means much of the substantive handle may require rediscovery across model families. Topic-substitution check: broad knowledge auditing alone would not justify this score; the synthetic-to-natural provenance predictor provides the specific lead-time handle that raises reach above the topic’s default probe-and-steering proposal.
